question: _______ is an annual allowance for wear and tear of a capital good.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Depreciation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Depreciation **is an annual allowance for wear and tear of a capital good.
 
• In simple terms means the decrease in the monetary value of an asset because of its wear and tear over the years.
 
• It may also become obsolete because of technological advancements over the years.
 
• It refers to determining the monetary value of the asset spread over its useful life years.
